metadata.description: Early-access channel of zigzag-plugins: same plugins, tracking main. Never enable both channels in the same scope (duplicate manifest name = silent shadowing, hooks fire twice).

plugins.name: lgtmgate
plugins.description: [beta channel, tracks main] Stack-agnostic delivery pipeline: Theo (diagnose) -> Mia (PM) -> Sam (plan) -> Nick (dev+PR) -> Morgan (review), orchestrated by a per-project workflow and configured via .claude/pipeline.config.json.

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: [beta channel, tracks main] Config-driven backlog discipline for GitHub repos: /backlog:file, /backlog:triage (propose-only), /backlog:next. Inert unless the repo has .claude/backlog.yml.
